impact: A direct hit to NBIS, MU, DRAM and SNXX a day before Nvidia earnings, following Seoul's memory rout; crypto weakness also weighs on HOOD. Nvidia's Tuesday guide is the swing factor.
summary: The selloff carried into Monday's session: the Nasdaq Composite was down about 1.4% by 11 a.m. ET and the S&P 500 about 1%. Nebius fell about 8% and CoreWeave 5.2%, Micron lost 5% to 7%, Broadcom 3.7% and Nvidia about 2%. Before the open, Nebius had been -5.5%, Micron -3.5% to -5% and bitcoin touched $64,000. Reuters noted some investors may sell tech holdings to make room for the Anthropic IPO.
title: AI selloff deepens at the open: Nebius -8%, Micron -5% to -7%, Nasdaq -1.4%
